full_judgment: 10. Mr. Mesbahul Islam (Asif), the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the judgment and decree passed by the appellate court is not a proper judgment of reversal in accordance with the provisions as laid down under Order 41 Rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure as the learned Judge of the trial court rightly and properly decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiffs with the findings that the suit is not barred by limitation as the defendant No. 1 fraudulently obtained the orders and deeds in question; that the deed of sale as well as deed of re- conveyance dated 11.02.1965 in question for 7 years expired on 11.02.1972 long before the promulgation of Section 95A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 dated 03.08.1972 under P.O. 44 of 1972 which is not applicable in the present suit; that A. Wahed Howlader had no saleable interest in the suit land after the said 11.02.1972 for which the deed dated 03.04.1974 being No. 2679 is inoperative and he had no possession of the suit land on 11.04.1974. The appellate court without adverting the aforesaid findings of the trial court improperly reversed the same and thereby committed an error of law which occasioned a failure of justice.
